description:
FOUND + FIXED s515a (Opus, 2026-10-11) by the #3184 detector recount (everyday, 10 announced sites in core Compress/Zlib.pm + IO/Uncompress/Base.pm).
`_extract_module_prototypes` skips every `IO::` module BY NAME (a cost measure), so `use IO::Compress::Base::Common;` never carried its prototypes: `use IO::Compress::Base::Common 2.212; my @r = (isaFilename "x", "y"); print scalar(@r)` -- perl 2, PCL 1 (silent wrong: both arguments passed to a ($) sub).
=== DONE (s515a) === a facts overlay lib/PCL/Facts/IO/Compress/Base/Common.pm (the nine prototyped subs + the seven use-constant names) -- the data layer, no Pl/ change.  Probe = perl; guard Pl/t/import-tag-01.t row 14 (fails on 973bdb1d).  The wider question (other IO:: modules with prototypes behind the same skip) is not measured here: the detector names them when a population reaches one.
subject: the prototype scan skips every IO:: module by name -- IO::Compress::Base::Common's ($) subs reach callers unprototyped (isaFilename "x", "y" passes both)
